head: Windows 11 webcam zoom missing after update on some Lenovo laptops
dek: Some owners of Lenovo laptops say their webcam's zoom, pan, tilt or automatic framing options disappeared after a Windows 11 update, while the camera itself still works. Microsoft hasn't confirmed a problem.
details: The reports name a ThinkPad T14 Gen 3 and an IdeaPad. One ThinkPad owner says the zoom control was there on build 26200.9168, gone on 26200.9278, and still missing after the November security update KB5132061; going back to the older build brought it back each time. Microsoft's release-health page listed no known issue for these controls on 19 November. The reports come from a few users, and the cause is unknown.
means: If your laptop's camera zoom or framing options vanished after an update, you're not alone, but there's no official fix yet.
todo: Use your video app's own crop or zoom for now, and check your camera maker's app for extra settings. Note your Windows build (Settings, System, About) before asking for support.
